description: GitHub facts for the merge policy, answered by the GitHub signal source in parmana-connectors (src/signal/github-signal-main.ts).
signedBy: The service's own Ed25519 key. Its public key is registered with Parmana through the maker and checker flow.
registeredThrough: Business signal source registration, approved by a checker, before the policy can use it.

repo.authorized.subject: target
repo.authorized.holds: The repository is on the service's allowed list. No GitHub call.

pr.branch-protected.subject: target
pr.branch-protected.holds: The pull request's base branch has classic branch protection.

pr.reviews-complete.subject: target
pr.reviews-complete.holds: At the expected head, the required approving reviews are given and no reviewer's latest review requests changes.

pr.checks-passing.subject: target
pr.checks-passing.holds: At the expected head, every check run completed with success, neutral or skipped, and every commit status is success.

knownGaps: Branch rulesets are not read. Only classic branch protection is.
